name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A library of ready-made plugins that teach Claude how a specific job (legal, finance, ops, etc.) actually gets done — its tools, its workflows, its slash commands — instead of starting from a blank slate every time.
buyer: An operations lead at a professional-services firm (consulting, accounting, legal) who wants every employee's Claude usage to follow the same firm-specific playbook.
business_use_cases: A consulting firm customizes a plugin with its own templates and terminology so every consultant's AI output looks and works the same way.
An accounting firm standardizes month-end close workflows across staff so output quality doesn't depend on who ran the AI.
A Claude-focused consultancy sells 'plugin customization' as a packaged service to firms adopting Cowork for the first time.

money_ideas.idea: Offer fixed-price plugin customization projects for professional-services firms rolling out Claude Cowork.
Run an ongoing retainer maintaining and updating a firm's custom plugin set as their processes change.

steal_this: Pick one repetitive task at a local professional-services firm (client intake, weekly reporting) this weekend, customize the closest plugin to match their exact process, and sell the customization as a fixed-price deliverable.
